final.summary: Flows balance through the ETP with no missing water, the tank stayed well below full, and outfall pH stayed near neutral throughout. Power followed the inflow load and the power feed was live, not replayed. Together this shows the batch wastewater passed through working treatment before discharge.

explanations.label: Normal operation: batch wastewater treated through working ETP
Bypass: untreated wastewater sent around ETP to outfall
Aeration cut: ETP inflow passed but blowers/power cut
Dilution: groundwater added to outfall masking effluent
Meter fault: one or more feeds unreliable for the stretch

key_evidence.why: All balances within tolerance with no unaccounted water, showing flow went through ETP.
Outfall pH stayed near neutral with no excursion above 9, ruling out raw wastewater in outfall.
Power tracked inflow load with almost no time below band, showing aeration ran.
Power feed not replayed, so power evidence can be relied on.
Meter photo matches feed and sits within expected band, confirming power feed.

final.scope_line: Based on flow, power, pH and conductivity records for 2026-10-13 18:00 to 2026-10-14 22:00. Does not measure every pollutant.
limitations: No lab BOD result covers the treatment interval, so organic pollutant removal is inferred from power and flow, not directly measured.
Meter photo covers only 2026-10-13 12:30, before the treatment interval, so it confirms feed trustworthiness generally, not power during the interval itself.
Logbook entries are factory claims, not facts, and were tested against signals rather than relied on.
Conductivity and pH show where water went, not every pollutant.

result.note: ETP balance: treated flow reaching the outfall vs outfall flow (same time). Boundary balance: intake vs outfall + losses + sludge water + tank storage change (reuse cancels). Tank balance: wastewater arriving (estimated from intake) vs ETP inflow + storage change; unaccounted water left the tank another way, or was intake water that never became wastewater. null means a required signal is under 80% coverage.
